title: Qualitätsentwicklung in Kitas: Wenn Entdecken und Forschen zum Alltag werden
summary: The book presents the programme "KiQ – Together for Childcare Quality". It also contains three expert reports on the topics of "Learning Kita", "Process support for daycare centres in change processes" and "Change processes in the elementary sector from a field-tested perspective", which served as the professional basis for the programme. In addition, the results of the scientific monitoring of the programme are highlighted.
